name: procurement-assistant
author: Farmers Market Vietnam
description: AI Procurement & Merchandising Assistant - Farmers Market

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix server run db:init
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:electron: tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --out-dir electron/dist --format cjs --external electron
scripts.app:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:all && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
